title: Find the top customer who paid in CZK and belongs to the KAM segment with t
question: Find the top customer who paid in CZK and belongs to the KAM segment with the highest total transaction amount (Amount × Price) in 2012. Return the descriptions of all products this customer purchased in 2012 along with the total spending per product.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.XCL_009 AS product_description,
       SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
FROM top_customer AS tc
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON tc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
GROUP BY p.XCL_009

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.XCL_009 AS product_description,
       SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
FROM top_customer AS tc
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON tc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
GROUP BY p.XCL_009

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.XCL_009 AS product_description,
       SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
FROM top_customer AS tc
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON tc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
GROUP BY p.XCL_009

    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'

      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'

    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1

SELECT p.XCL_009 AS product_description,
       SUM(t.XCL_017 * t.XCL_018) AS total_spending

JOIN transactions_1k t ON tc.customer_id = t.XCL_013

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    p.XCL_009 AS product_description,
    SUM(t.XCL_015 * t.XCL_018) AS total_spending
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
JOIN products p ON t.XCL_014 = p.XCL_008
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'KAM'
  AND t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
  AND t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01'
  AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
  AND t.XCL_013 = (
      SELECT t2.XCL_013
      FROM transactions_1k t2
      JOIN customers c2 ON t2.XCL_013 = c2.XCL_001
      WHERE c2.XCL_003 = 'KAM'
        AND t2.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
        AND t2.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01'
        AND t2.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
      GROUP BY t2.XCL_013
      ORDER BY SUM(t2.XCL_015 * t2.XCL_018) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_009
